repo.name: emotion
repo.description: 👩‍🎤 CSS-in-JS library designed for high performance style composition

readme.summary: Good high-level introduction with a quick start example, but relies heavily on external docs for configuration and provides no troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No configuration or troubleshooting documentation — users hitting issues with Babel plugin, TypeScript setup, or SSR are sent elsewhere with no in-README guidance.

security.summary: The code appears to be secure with no major security concerns identified.

common_complaints: Lack of React 19 RSC support (falling behind styled-components)
SSR support incomplete for React 18+ (renderToPipeableStream open since 2022)
Outdated peer dependency constraints (ESLint 9 support pending since July 2024)
praise_themes: Active community engagement and issue reporting
Recent issues show package is still in use
sentiment.summary: The @emotion/react project shows moderate maintenance with slow response cycles—critical feature parity gaps with styled-components remain unfilled, core dependency constraints outdated for 8+ months, and multi-year-old feature requests unresolved despite community engagement, indicating resource constraints rather than active development.

red_flags: Some responses could be more detailed for less experienced users
Patience with repeated or basic questions is not always evident
communication.summary: The maintainer provides helpful and technically sound responses, though clarity can vary and patience with repetitive queries is sometimes lacking.

concerns: No commits in past 6 months despite last commit being ~4.5 months ago
371 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months - severe backlog accumulation
Zero merged PRs in past 6 months indicates no active development
No active contributors in past 6 months
Unknown release status - unable to determine release frequency or recency
positive_signals: Project still exists and hasn't been archived
At least one commit occurred 4-5 months ago showing some recent activity
maintenance.summary: @emotion/react appears stale with no active development, no issue resolution, and a growing backlog of 371 unaddressed issues over the past 6 months.

changelog.summary: The changelog is generally clear and well-structured, but lacks comprehensive coverage for all versions.

governance.summary: The governance documentation for the npm package '@emotion/react' does not address succession planning, decision-making processes, or multiple maintainers. It provides a path for contributors to become more involved through changeset contributions but lacks comprehensive guidance on leadership transition and collaborative decision-making.
